title: The I3322 quantum value: certified window, spatial attainment, finite-dimensional nonattainment, and the Cqs/Cq separation
description: Certified two-sided window for the I3322 quantum supremum S, tensor/commuting value equality, finite-dimensional nonattainment of S, nonclosure of C_q(3,3;2,2), and (v3.1.0) normal spatial attainment of S giving a nonempty separation C_qs \ C_q - each established by routes that survived independent refutation-first adversarial review, with the full review records and correction history shipped in-repository. The exact optimum beyond the certified 3.61e-9 window and the dimension-necessity lower bound remain open.
